newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound eases slightly against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound eases slightly against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound eased a little against the dollar on Thursday in a private sector market with more supply of the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"There is some demand but there is more supply. Many banks were also square," one banker said.
Five actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3880 and 3.3935 pounds bid, and 3.3900 and 3.3940 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Thursday was 3.3915 pounds bid and 3.3931 pounds offered, compared to 3.3876 pounds bid and 3.3920 pounds offered on Tuesday. Banks were closed on Wednesday for a public holiday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.387188 pounds buy and 3.392618 pounds sell.
